title: NHL All-Star Hockey
overview:
Sega Sports Power Play!

- Saturn's Video Motion System graphics ensure all the action and detail of a real game.
- Over 16 different 3-D playing perspectives including a first-person view, and Sega Saturn's own "Puck Cam" instant replay feature.
- Exciting live-action sequences include coaching based on your performance in the last period, and actual footage from the '94 season.
- And of course, all the real hockey features you expect from Sega Sports: multiple checks, power plays, slapshots, home ice advantage, penalties, and more.

Marv Albert commentary.
